question: Jadę samochodem. Wymień apteki w pobliżu stacji Krusze.

steps.sql: select fid,fclass,name,ST_AsText(geom) from gis_osm_transport_free where name ilike '%Krusze%' union all select fid,fclass,name,ST_AsText(ST_Centroid(geom)) from gis_osm_traffic_free where name ilike '%Krusze%' union all select fid,fclass,name,ST_AsText(ST_Centroid(geom)) from gis_osm_traffic_a_free where name ilike '%Krusze%'

with s as (select geom from gis_osm_transport_free where fid=2995) select p.name, 'pt' src, round(ST_Distance(p.geom::geography,s.geom::geography)) d from gis_osm_pois_free p, s where fclass='pharmacy' union all select p.name,'poly', round(ST_Distance(p.geom::geography,s.geom::geography)) from gis_osm_pois_a_free p, s where fclass='pharmacy' order by d limit 10

with s as (select geom from gis_osm_transport_free where fid=2995) select p.name, p.osm_id, round(ST_Distance(p.geom::geography,s.geom::geography)) as odleglosc_m from (select name,osm_id,geom from gis_osm_pois_free where fclass='pharmacy' union all select name,osm_id,geom from gis_osm_pois_a_free where fclass='pharmacy') p, s where ST_DWithin(p.geom::geography,s.geom::geography,6000) order by odleglosc_m

with s as (select geom from gis_osm_transport_free where fid=2995) select p.name, p.osm_id, round(ST_Distance(p.geom::geography,s.geom::geography)) as odleglosc_m from (select name,osm_id,geom from gis_osm_pois_free where fclass='pharmacy' union all select name,osm_id,geom from gis_osm_pois_a_free where fclass='pharmacy') p, s where ST_DWithin(p.geom::geography,s.geom::geography,6000) order by odleglosc_m
select 1

sql: with s as (select geom from gis_osm_transport_free where fid=2995) select p.name, p.osm_id, round(ST_Distance(p.geom::geography,s.geom::geography)) as odleglosc_m from (select name,osm_id,geom from gis_osm_pois_free where fclass='pharmacy' union all select name,osm_id,geom from gis_osm_pois_a_free where fclass='pharmacy') p, s where ST_DWithin(p.geom::geography,s.geom::geography,6000) order by odleglosc_m

uwagi: Stacje metra: obiekty railway_station w Warszawie w odległości do 100 m od torów subway. Kawiarnie liczone z tabel punktowej i poligonowej (poligony traktowane jako osobne obiekty), każda kawiarnia raz.

select p.name, p.fclass, round(ST_Distance(p.geom::geography,s.geom::geography)) d from gis_osm_pois_free p, gis_osm_transport_free s where s.fid=4113 and p.fclass='pharmacy' and ST_DWithin(p.geom::geography,s.geom::geography,1000) order by d

select name, d from (select p.name, ST_Distance(p.geom::geography,s.geom::geography) d from gis_osm_pois_free p, gis_osm_transport_free s where s.fid=4113 and p.fclass='pharmacy' union all select p.name, ST_Distance(p.geom::geography,s.geom::geography) from gis_osm_pois_a_free p, gis_osm_transport_free s where s.fid=4113 and p.fclass='pharmacy') x where d<=1500 order by d

select name, round(d) as odleglosc_m from (select p.name, ST_Distance(p.geom::geography,s.geom::geography) d from gis_osm_pois_free p, gis_osm_transport_free s where s.fid=4113 and p.fclass='pharmacy' union all select p.name, ST_Distance(p.geom::geography,s.geom::geography) from gis_osm_pois_a_free p, gis_osm_transport_free s where s.fid=4113 and p.fclass='pharmacy') x where d<=1500 order by d

uwagi: Stacja to przystanek kolejowy 'Warszawa Płudy' (railway_halt). Przyjąłem, że 'w pobliżu' oznacza promień 1500 m. Szukałem w tabelach punktowej i poligonowej. W tym promieniu są dwie apteki: Apteka Klasyków (ok. 954 m) i Hipokrates (ok. 1341 m).

question: Ile kawiarni w Warszawie jest w odległości do 200 metrów od stacji metra?

with d as (select geom::geography g from gis_osm_transport_free where fclass='railway_station' and name='Warszawa Centralna') select p.name, round(st_distance(p.geom::geography,d.g)) dist_m from gis_osm_pois_free p, d where p.fclass='pharmacy' and st_dwithin(p.geom::geography,d.g,600) union all select p.name, round(st_distance(p.geom::geography,d.g)) from gis_osm_pois_a_free p, d where p.fclass='pharmacy' and st_dwithin(p.geom::geography,d.g,600) order by dist_m

sql: with d as (select geom::geography g from gis_osm_transport_free where fclass='railway_station' and name='Warszawa Centralna') select p.name, round(st_distance(p.geom::geography,d.g)) dist_m from gis_osm_pois_free p, d where p.fclass='pharmacy' and st_dwithin(p.geom::geography,d.g,500) union all select p.name, round(st_distance(p.geom::geography,d.g)) from gis_osm_pois_a_free p, d where p.fclass='pharmacy' and st_dwithin(p.geom::geography,d.g,500) order by dist_m
